name: Contract master data completeness
purpose: Ensures every bid claim can be tied to a governed contract record.
definition: Required contract master fields completed and current.
targetGuidance: Internal target; amend if governance standard differs.
evidence: Completed contract record and review date

name: Contract reports submitted on time
purpose: Demonstrates dependable commissioner reporting.
definition: Required reports submitted by the contractual deadline.

name: Contract KPI compliance
purpose: Provides an overall contractual performance statement.
definition: Contractual KPIs meeting their defined target in the period.

name: Contract variations logged before implementation
purpose: Proves change control and protects delivery assumptions.
definition: Service changes with an approved variation record before implementation.
targetGuidance: All material variations should be recorded.

name: Invoice accuracy
purpose: Supports claims of disciplined financial administration.
definition: Invoices accepted without correction, credit note or resubmission.

name: Disputed invoice value rate
purpose: Identifies commercial leakage and recurring ambiguity.
definition: Value formally disputed by commissioner as a share of invoiced value.

name: Commissioner action closure on time
purpose: Evidences responsiveness and accountability.
definition: Commissioner or contract review actions completed by due date.

name: Required contract meeting attendance
purpose: Demonstrates active partnership governance.
definition: Required meetings attended by an appropriately authorised DRPA representative.

name: Specification changes implemented on time
purpose: Shows DRPA can translate instructions into delivery.
definition: Approved specification changes implemented by the agreed effective date.

name: Commissioner relationship score
purpose: Creates trend evidence beyond anecdotal feedback.
definition: Average structured commissioner survey or review score.

name: Commissioned delivery rate
purpose: Primary proof that DRPA delivers contracted services.
definition: Commissioned clinical hours or sessions actually delivered.
targetGuidance: Report gross and DRPA-controllable versions separately.
evidence: Signed rota, timesheet or commissioner report

name: Rota filled eight weeks ahead
purpose: Shows long-range workforce planning.
definition: Planned hours with an accepted worker eight weeks before delivery.
targetGuidance: Snapshot on the same day each week.

name: Rota filled four weeks ahead
purpose: Key predictor of safe, stable delivery.
definition: Planned hours with an accepted worker four weeks before delivery.
targetGuidance: Snapshot on the same day each week.

name: Rota filled two weeks ahead
purpose: Shows near-term readiness.
definition: Planned hours with an accepted worker two weeks before delivery.
targetGuidance: Snapshot on the same day each week.

name: Short-notice gap rate
purpose: Quantifies last-minute instability.
definition: Commissioned hours becoming unfilled within 72 hours of planned start.

name: Provider-controlled lost hours
purpose: Provides honest accountability for DRPA-controlled non-delivery.
definition: Commissioned hours not delivered for reasons controlled by DRPA.
targetGuidance: Maintain agreed reason codes and evidence.

name: Site or commissioner constrained hours
purpose: Separates prison or commissioner barriers from DRPA failure.
definition: Planned delivery prevented by lockdown, escorts, rooms, cancellation or other site-controlled cause.
targetGuidance: Always show reason and evidence; do not set as a DRPA failure target.

name: Urgent cover success rate
purpose: Proves access to a responsive deployable pool.
definition: Urgent cover requests accepted and delivered within the requested window.
targetGuidance: Define request window and eligible requests.

name: Median time to confirm urgent cover
purpose: Quantifies responsiveness rather than relying on narrative.
definition: Median elapsed minutes from confirmed request to accepted cover.

name: Regular clinician continuity rate
purpose: Demonstrates continuity, local knowledge and relationship stability.
definition: Delivered hours provided by clinicians meeting the agreed regular-worker definition.
targetGuidance: Define regular as an agreed number of sessions in trailing 12 weeks.

name: Premium or external agency dependency
purpose: Shows whether delivery is sustainable and cost-controlled.
definition: Hours delivered at premium or through an external agency.
targetGuidance: Separate DRPA bank from external agency.

name: Sessions starting on time
purpose: Evidences day-to-day reliability.
definition: Delivered sessions starting within the agreed tolerance.
targetGuidance: Define tolerance, e.g. 15 minutes, by contract.

name: Service interruption rate
purpose: Tracks resilience and patient impact.
definition: Material interruptions to commissioned service per 1,000 delivered hours.

name: Operational escalation response within target
purpose: Shows risks are acted upon promptly.
definition: Operational escalations acknowledged and assigned within target.

name: On-call response within target
purpose: Supports claims of out-of-hours leadership support.
definition: Eligible on-call contacts answered or returned within the defined target.

name: Activated surge hours delivered
purpose: Demonstrates ability to scale safely when surge is commissioned.
definition: Verified surge hours delivered against formally activated surge requirement.
targetGuidance: Use only where surge has been formally activated.

name: Required simultaneous deployment availability
purpose: Proves readiness for requirements such as vessel or multiple-location coverage.
definition: Periods where the required number and mix of staff were simultaneously available.
targetGuidance: Define interval and staffing mix in contract.

name: Repeat gap recurrence rate
purpose: Shows whether corrective actions prevent recurrence.
definition: Provider-controlled gaps repeating the same site/service/cause within 30 days.

name: Available appointment or clinic capacity
purpose: Establishes the capacity DRPA made available.
definition: Total appointment slots, clinic places or assessment capacity made available.

name: Completed clinical contacts
purpose: Shows activity and service reach.
definition: Completed patient-facing clinical contacts, counted once using an agreed contact definition.
targetGuidance: Separate face-to-face, remote and multidisciplinary contacts.

name: Clinic utilisation rate
purpose: Shows whether available capacity is converted into care.
definition: Completed contacts as a share of available bookable capacity.

name: Patient DNA rate
purpose: Supports demand management and pathway redesign.
definition: Appointments where the patient did not attend and no operational barrier was recorded.
targetGuidance: Keep separate from patient decline and operational non-attendance.

name: Patient decline rate
purpose: Identifies engagement barriers and informed refusal.
definition: Appointments or assessments explicitly declined by the patient.
targetGuidance: Record reason where appropriate without patient identifiers.

name: Operational non-attendance rate
purpose: Quantifies access lost through regime or prison operations.
definition: Appointments not completed due to escorts, unlocks, court, transfer, release, lockdown or room availability.

name: Urgent assessments within target
purpose: Evidences timely response to urgent need.
definition: Urgent referrals receiving clinical assessment within the specified target.
targetGuidance: Use contractual target and severity bands.

name: Median routine waiting time
purpose: Provides a robust access measure less affected by outliers.
definition: Median calendar days from accepted referral/request to first offered appointment.

name: Patients waiting beyond target
purpose: Identifies backlog and inequity hidden by averages.
definition: Open referrals waiting longer than the applicable standard at period end.

name: Initial reception screening in time
purpose: Essential evidence for prison reception pathways.
definition: Eligible new receptions receiving initial health screening within the required timescale.

name: Secondary health assessment in time
purpose: Demonstrates completion of the reception pathway.
definition: Eligible patients receiving secondary assessment within the required timescale.

name: Prescription requests completed within target
purpose: Addresses a common operational and safety concern.
definition: Eligible prescription requests clinically completed within the agreed target.
targetGuidance: Separate urgent, routine and controlled-drug tasks.

name: Clinical tasks completed within target
purpose: Shows responsiveness to the wider task workload.
definition: Eligible clinical tasks completed within service-specific target.
targetGuidance: Define task categories and clock stops.

name: Required segregation rounds completed
purpose: Provides direct evidence of secure healthcare obligations.
definition: Required segregation or equivalent rounds completed and documented.

name: Referrals completed within pathway target
purpose: Shows end-to-end pathway management.
definition: Referrals reaching the defined completed stage within the applicable target.

name: Overdue referral follow-up rate
purpose: Flags lost or stalled referrals.
definition: Open referrals without required follow-up beyond the target interval.

name: Eligible long-term condition reviews completed
purpose: Adds outcome-oriented planned-care evidence.
definition: Eligible reviews completed within the defined recall period.

name: Eligible vaccination or screening uptake
purpose: Supports public-health and health-inequality responses.
definition: Eligible patients receiving the specified vaccination or screening.

name: Appropriate remote contact rate
purpose: Quantifies digital delivery and travel avoidance without overclaiming.
definition: Contacts delivered remotely where remote delivery met clinical and contractual criteria.
targetGuidance: Audit suitability and outcomes; not a blanket higher-is-better measure.

name: Demand to capacity ratio
purpose: Provides evidence for proposed staffing and service redesign.
definition: Eligible demand received compared with available service capacity.
targetGuidance: Interpret above 100% as pressure and below as potential underuse.

name: Cancelled clinics rebooked within target
purpose: Shows recovery from disruption.
definition: Affected appointments reoffered within agreed recovery period after cancellation.

name: Patient safety incidents per 1,000 contacts
purpose: Normalises incident volume for service scale.
definition: Reportable patient safety incidents per 1,000 completed clinical contacts.
targetGuidance: Interpret with severity and reporting culture.

name: Severe harm or death incidents
purpose: Tracks highest-consequence events requiring executive oversight.
definition: Incidents classified as severe harm or death under the applicable framework.
targetGuidance: All require immediate escalation and contextual review.
evidence: Investigation and duty of candour evidence

name: Near-miss reporting rate
purpose: Indicates proactive identification of risk.
definition: Near misses reported per 1,000 contacts.
targetGuidance: Do not treat a higher rate automatically as poor performance.

name: Incident investigations completed on time
purpose: Shows disciplined safety governance.
definition: Incident investigations completed by their assigned deadline.

name: Clinical governance actions completed on time
purpose: Demonstrates that learning becomes action.
definition: Clinical governance actions closed with evidence by due date.

name: Avoidable harm finding rate
purpose: Provides a stronger outcome measure than incident count alone.
definition: Reviewed incidents where avoidable harm was substantiated.
targetGuidance: Use independent review standard where appropriate.

name: Medication-related incident rate
purpose: Supports medicines-management assurance.
definition: Medication-related incidents per 1,000 relevant contacts or prescriptions.

name: Prescribing audit compliance
purpose: Provides direct evidence of prescribing quality.
definition: Audited prescribing items meeting all agreed audit standards.

name: Clinical record audit compliance
purpose: Demonstrates record quality and defensible care.
definition: Audited clinical records meeting all agreed documentation standards.

name: Safeguarding concerns acted on within target
purpose: Evidences timely protection of vulnerable people.
definition: Safeguarding concerns assessed, escalated or referred within target.

name: IPC audit compliance
purpose: Supports safe environment and outbreak readiness.
definition: Applicable IPC audit standards met.

name: Complaints per 1,000 contacts
purpose: Normalises complaint volume and identifies trends.
definition: Formal complaints received per 1,000 completed contacts.
targetGuidance: Interpret by theme and whether upheld.

name: Complaint responses within target
purpose: Demonstrates responsive complaint handling.
definition: Complaints receiving a compliant response within the required timeframe.

name: Upheld complaint rate
purpose: Distinguishes complaint volume from substantiated shortcomings.
definition: Closed complaints upheld or partially upheld.

name: Compliments received
purpose: Captures positive experience evidence for bids.
definition: Verified compliments relating to DRPA staff or services.
targetGuidance: Retain exact source and permission status.

name: Planned audits completed
purpose: Shows governance plan is delivered.
definition: Audits completed within the period they were scheduled.

name: Re-audits showing improvement
purpose: Proves that audit activity changes performance.
definition: Re-audits with improved score or maintained full compliance.

name: QI projects delivering stated outcome
purpose: Creates quantified improvement case studies.
definition: Completed QI projects achieving their pre-defined measurable outcome.
targetGuidance: Outcomes must be defined before implementation.

name: Policies and SOPs reviewed on time
purpose: Demonstrates current governance documentation.
definition: Policies/SOPs reviewed and approved by their scheduled date.

name: Clinical governance attendance
purpose: Evidences active oversight across sites.
definition: Required DRPA attendees present at governance meetings.
targetGuidance: Record substitutes and reason for absence.

name: Safety learning shared within target
purpose: Shows learning reaches frontline teams.
definition: Required safety learning communications issued and acknowledged within target.
targetGuidance: Use read-and-understood evidence for critical items.

name: Unplanned emergency transfer rate
purpose: Can identify deterioration or pathway failure when clinically attributable.
definition: Unplanned emergency transfers per 1,000 contacts, with clinical review of cause.
targetGuidance: Do not imply all transfers are avoidable.

name: Required WTE filled
purpose: Demonstrates workforce establishment coverage.
definition: Filled deployable WTE against the agreed required establishment.

name: Vacancy rate
purpose: Shows stability and mobilisation risk.
definition: Unfilled established WTE as a share of required WTE.
targetGuidance: Use deployable rather than contracted-only status.

name: Median time to accepted offer
purpose: Evidences recruitment speed.
definition: Median calendar days from approved requisition to accepted offer.

name: Median time from offer to deployable
purpose: Critical evidence for secure-setting mobilisation.
definition: Median days from accepted offer to all required clearances and readiness complete.
targetGuidance: Break down DBS, prison, immigration and IT clearance delays.

name: Clearance success rate
purpose: Shows quality of candidate screening.
definition: Submitted candidates completing all required clearance successfully.
targetGuidance: Exclude candidates still within normal processing time.

name: Offer acceptance rate
purpose: Indicates competitiveness and candidate engagement.
definition: Formal offers accepted.

name: Site induction before first deployment
purpose: Provides assurance that workers are site-ready.
definition: Workers completing required site induction before first shift.
targetGuidance: No exceptions without documented risk approval.

name: Mandatory training compliance
purpose: Standard assurance required in most bids.
definition: In-scope workers fully compliant with all mandatory training due.
targetGuidance: Report individual course exceptions and expiry risk.

name: Role or contract-specific training compliance
purpose: Shows readiness for secure and specialist services.
definition: Workers compliant with all role and contract-specific training requirements.
targetGuidance: Include RCGP secure environment requirements where applicable.

name: Required supervision completed on time
purpose: Common commissioner assurance requirement.
definition: Clinical or managerial supervision completed within the agreed frequency.

name: Appraisal and revalidation compliance
purpose: Evidences professional governance.
definition: Workers with required appraisal, licence and revalidation status current.
targetGuidance: Escalate any expired professional status immediately.

name: Annualised workforce turnover
purpose: Provides comparable evidence of workforce stability.
definition: Leavers in the period annualised against average headcount.
targetGuidance: Separate voluntary, involuntary and contract-end leavers.

name: Three-month new-starter retention
purpose: Tests early recruitment quality and onboarding.
definition: Eligible starters still active three months after deployment.
targetGuidance: Use deployment date, not offer date.

name: Six-month new-starter retention
purpose: Shows medium-term workforce sustainability.
definition: Eligible starters still active six months after deployment.

name: Twelve-month retention
purpose: Provides strong bid evidence on continuity.
definition: Eligible starters or existing workers retained for 12 months.

name: Sickness absence rate
purpose: Monitors capacity and staff wellbeing.
definition: Sickness hours as a share of contracted or scheduled hours.

name: Staff engagement score
purpose: Provides evidence of culture and workforce voice.
definition: Achieved score as a share of maximum score on a consistent survey.
targetGuidance: Always report response rate alongside score.

name: Staff survey response rate
purpose: Shows reliability of engagement findings.
definition: Eligible workers completing the survey.

name: Wellbeing support utilisation
purpose: Shows access to practical staff support.
definition: Anonymised use of EAP, wellbeing or structured support per 100 workers.
targetGuidance: Do not interpret higher use automatically as poor wellbeing.

name: Exit interview completion
purpose: Improves understanding of avoidable turnover.
definition: Eligible leavers completing an exit interview or structured questionnaire.

name: Regular worker share
purpose: Workforce version of continuity showing stable deployment.
definition: Delivered hours provided by regular workers under the agreed definition.

name: Workforce representation monitoring completeness
purpose: Supports equality reporting without setting inappropriate quotas.
definition: Workforce records with complete voluntary equality-monitoring fields.

name: Mobilisation milestones achieved on time
purpose: Primary evidence that DRPA can mobilise complex services.
definition: Mobilisation milestones completed by planned deadline.

name: Contract award to operational go-live
purpose: Quantifies mobilisation speed for case studies.
definition: Calendar days from formal award/notice to proceed to operational go-live.

name: Eligible TUPE staff retained at go-live
purpose: Shows workforce engagement and continuity through transfer.
definition: Eligible transferring staff active at go-live.
targetGuidance: Document opt-outs and roles not required.

name: Required roles filled by go-live
purpose: Demonstrates operational readiness.
definition: Required establishment filled by deployable workers at go-live.

name: Required staff fully cleared by go-live
purpose: Critical secure-setting readiness measure.
definition: Staff required for go-live with all applicable clearances complete.

name: Go-live workforce inducted
purpose: Assures site and role readiness.
definition: Required go-live workers completing corporate, contract and site induction.

name: Required IT and clinical-system access ready
purpose: Prevents avoidable day-one delivery failures.
definition: Required users with tested access before first shift.
targetGuidance: Track requests, approvals and external delays.

name: Required equipment available and tested
purpose: Shows safe operational setup.
definition: Required equipment present, functional and accepted before go-live.

name: Required policies and SOPs approved
purpose: Evidences governed mobilisation rather than staffing alone.
definition: Required mobilisation policies, SOPs and pathways approved by deadline.

name: Governance structure live before go-live
purpose: Shows management and escalation readiness.
definition: Required governance meetings, reporting routes and escalation contacts established and tested.

name: Critical mobilisation risks mitigated
purpose: Shows active risk control.
definition: Critical risks closed or reduced to an approved tolerable level by due date.

name: Service continuity through transition
purpose: Proves safe transfer without avoidable loss of service.
definition: Commissioned service hours delivered during transition and initial go-live period.
targetGuidance: Report inherited and external constraints separately.

name: Mobilisation-related safety incidents
purpose: Identifies transition harm and learning.
definition: Safety incidents where mobilisation or transition was a contributing factor.

name: First 90-day KPI compliance
purpose: Shows mobilisation translates into stable delivery.
definition: Applicable KPIs meeting target during the first 90 days.
denominator: KPI results due in first 90 days
targetGuidance: Report improvement from month one to three.

name: Commissioner mobilisation satisfaction
purpose: Creates reference-quality evidence.
definition: Structured commissioner score after mobilisation.
targetGuidance: Seek permission for future bid reference.

name: Patient feedback response rate
purpose: Shows how representative experience results are.
definition: Completed feedback responses as a share of people invited or eligible.
targetGuidance: Use a realistic local target and accessible methods.

name: Patient satisfaction score
purpose: Provides outcome evidence from service users.
definition: Positive score achieved on a consistent patient experience instrument.

name: Patient feedback actions completed
purpose: Demonstrates that feedback changes services.
definition: Agreed patient-feedback actions completed by due date.
targetGuidance: Publish an anonymised 'you said, we did' summary.

name: Patient participation activities delivered
purpose: Supports co-production and engagement claims.
definition: Planned participation, forum or listening activities delivered.

name: Requested reasonable adjustments delivered
purpose: Evidences equitable access.
definition: Eligible reasonable adjustments delivered as agreed.

name: Interpreting requests fulfilled
purpose: Shows language access and safety.
definition: Eligible interpreting requests fulfilled in the required mode and timeframe.

name: Accessible information requests fulfilled
purpose: Supports compliance and inclusion.
definition: Requests for accessible formats fulfilled within the agreed timeframe.

name: Health inequality actions delivered
purpose: Creates evidence that inequalities analysis leads to intervention.
definition: Agreed actions addressing an identified inequality completed on time.
targetGuidance: Link each action to quantified baseline where possible.

name: Service changes co-designed with patients
purpose: Supports genuine co-production claims.
definition: Material service changes with documented patient involvement in design.
targetGuidance: Apply only where co-design is appropriate and feasible.

name: Informal concerns resolved within target
purpose: Captures early resolution before formal complaint.
definition: Informal concerns resolved or escalated within the local target.

name: Local recruits appointed
purpose: Provides tangible local economic value.
definition: New starters meeting the agreed local-area definition.

name: Local recruits retained 12 months
purpose: Shows local jobs are sustainable, not short-lived.
definition: Eligible local recruits still active after 12 months.

name: Apprenticeships created
purpose: Supports skills and employment commitments.
definition: New apprenticeship opportunities commenced in the period.

name: Placements and work experience delivered
purpose: Demonstrates entry pathways into healthcare.
definition: Completed placements or work-experience opportunities.

name: Additional training hours delivered
purpose: Quantifies investment beyond mandatory training.
definition: Structured development hours delivered beyond mandatory requirements.

name: Employee volunteering hours
purpose: Quantifies community contribution.
definition: Approved employee volunteering hours delivered.

name: Spend with SMEs
purpose: Supports local and diverse supply-chain commitments.
definition: Eligible supplier spend paid to SMEs.
targetGuidance: Define exclusions and verify supplier classification.

name: Spend with local suppliers
purpose: Quantifies local economic impact.
definition: Eligible supplier spend paid to suppliers meeting local definition.

name: Disability Confident commitments delivered
purpose: Evidences disability-inclusive employment practices.
definition: Planned Disability Confident actions completed.

name: Business travel emissions
purpose: Provides baseline and reduction evidence.
definition: Estimated tonnes CO2e from business travel using an approved methodology.
targetGuidance: Retain factors, mileage and method by reporting year.

name: Travel miles avoided through appropriate remote delivery
purpose: Quantifies a tangible benefit of remote support.
definition: Estimated return travel miles avoided where remote delivery was clinically appropriate.
targetGuidance: Do not count activity unsuitable for remote delivery.

name: Paper use reduction
purpose: Supports environmental improvement claims.
definition: Reduction in purchased or consumed paper against baseline.

name: Verified environmental restoration contribution
purpose: Records initiatives such as verified tree planting without overstating offset.
definition: Verified units funded or delivered through an environmental programme.
targetGuidance: Describe as contribution, not carbon neutrality unless independently verified.

name: Social value commitments achieved
purpose: Gives an overall contract social-value performance measure.
definition: Contract social-value commitments achieved by their deadline.
targetGuidance: Weight commitments if commissioner methodology requires.

name: Revenue versus budget
purpose: Shows commercial control and delivery-linked variance.
definition: Actual recognised revenue compared with approved budget.
targetGuidance: Analyse volume, rate and timing variances.

name: Gross margin versus budget
purpose: Protects sustainability of each contract.
definition: Actual gross margin percentage compared with approved budget margin.
targetGuidance: Store budget margin separately in contract target.

name: Clinical cost per delivered session
purpose: Supports evidence-based pricing for future bids.
definition: Direct clinical labour cost divided by delivered sessions.
targetGuidance: Segment by profession and session duration.

name: Cost per completed contact
purpose: Links resources to activity and efficiency.
definition: Applicable delivery cost divided by completed clinical contacts.

name: Premium cover cost rate
purpose: Tracks the cost of instability and urgent cover.
definition: Premium above standard rate as a share of direct clinical labour cost.
targetGuidance: Separate external agency and DRPA premium.

name: Cost of provider-controlled lost activity
purpose: Quantifies financial impact of non-delivery.
definition: Estimated revenue loss, service credit or replacement cost arising from DRPA-controlled gaps.
targetGuidance: Use approved methodology and avoid double counting.

name: Open disputed invoice value
purpose: Highlights unresolved commercial exposure.
definition: Value of submitted invoices under active dispute at period end.

name: Debtor days
purpose: Supports cash-flow control.
definition: Trade receivables divided by trailing credit sales, converted to days.
targetGuidance: Set by payment terms and internal policy.

name: Three-month forecast accuracy
purpose: Shows quality of commercial planning.
definition: Absolute forecast error as a share of actual value, expressed as accuracy.
targetGuidance: Calculate separately for revenue and cost.

name: Verified recurring efficiency savings
purpose: Creates value-for-money evidence for bids.
definition: Annualised recurring savings validated against an agreed baseline.

name: Verified QI financial benefit
purpose: Links improvement activity to quantified benefit.
definition: Financial benefit attributable to a completed QI initiative and validated by Finance.
targetGuidance: Avoid claiming unvalidated avoidance as realised savings.

name: Subcontractor cost variance
purpose: Controls partner delivery and bid assumptions.
definition: Actual subcontractor cost compared with approved budget.

name: Mobilisation budget variance
purpose: Shows ability to mobilise within commercial plan.
definition: Actual mobilisation cost variance from approved budget.
targetGuidance: Separate one-off, delayed and commissioner-funded items.

name: Service credits or financial deductions
purpose: Tracks direct commercial consequences of performance.
definition: Value of service credits, deductions or penalties applied in period.
targetGuidance: Record disputed and accepted amounts separately.

name: Required KPI fields complete
purpose: Ensures the bid dataset is usable and auditable.
definition: KPI records with all required metadata and values completed.
targetGuidance: Define required fields in the data dictionary.

name: KPI records validated on time
purpose: Prevents stale or unverified bid claims.
definition: KPI records validated by deadline.

name: KPI records with linked evidence
purpose: Allows claims to withstand commissioner scrutiny.
definition: Applicable KPI records with a retrievable evidence reference.
targetGuidance: Not every operational row needs an attachment; define evidence rule.

name: KPI source traceability
purpose: Ensures every figure can be reproduced.
definition: KPI records with source system, reporting period and owner recorded.
targetGuidance: No unsupported KPI should be bid-ready.

name: Duplicate record rate
purpose: Prevents double counting across sites and systems.
definition: Duplicate records identified as a share of records reviewed.
targetGuidance: Use stable record IDs and duplicate checks.

name: Exception reason completeness
purpose: Makes delivery figures interpretable and defensible.
definition: Exceptions/non-delivery records with an approved reason code and narrative where required.

name: Control attribution completeness
purpose: Separates DRPA, site, patient and external causes.
definition: Exception records with validated control attribution.

name: Formula or logic error rate
purpose: Prevents incorrect figures entering bids.
definition: Records failing validation rules or formula checks.

name: Overdue validation rate
purpose: Highlights bottlenecks in ownership.
definition: KPI records past validation deadline and not approved.

name: KPI results reconciled to source
purpose: Confirms workbook figures match authoritative systems.
definition: Sampled or required KPI results reconciled without unexplained difference.

name: Critical source data available by deadline
purpose: Identifies dependencies on commissioners or systems.
definition: Critical data sources received or accessible by reporting deadline.
targetGuidance: Log external dependency and chase activity.

name: Data correction turnaround
purpose: Shows errors are corrected promptly and transparently.
definition: Median business days from confirmed error to corrected and revalidated record.
targetGuidance: Set shorter target for published reports.
